note: Spend 录入异常字典的种子（v1）：全部来自 Slack 镜像里的真实案例，例子的原话逐字取自 raw/slack。线上学到的内容在 knowledge/spend_dictionary.json，不覆盖本文件。

entries.name_zh: 利润率过期或没随计算方式更新
entries.name_en: Stale margin / margin not updated with the calculation
entries.desc_zh: gross 由 net/(1-利润率) 算出，利润率设置没跟上（改了又改回、合作方算法变了），导致 gross 偏高或偏低。
entries.desc_en: Gross is derived from net/(1-margin); the margin setting lagged behind (changed and reverted, or the partner's calculation changed), so gross is over- or under-stated.
entries.fix_zh: 把利润率改回应有的值，并按正确利润率重算受影响日期的 gross。
entries.fix_en: Set the margin to the intended value and recalculate gross for the affected dates.

examples.quote: gross is still overstated by $1,193.17 on 10 Remerge click URLs (Oct 5–11 stale margins)
你这边手动修改spend但是margin跟系统的30%不一致，除了这个URL其他也有这样的情况

entries.name_zh: spend 计算公式 / 系数 / 来源不对
entries.name_en: Wrong spend formula, factor or source
entries.desc_zh: spend request 里的公式、系数（如 net = 合作方 × 95%）或取数来源不对，或合作方改了算法而配置没跟上。
entries.desc_en: The spend request formula, factor (e.g. net = partner cost × 95%) or data source is wrong, or the partner changed its calculation and the configuration did not follow.
entries.fix_zh: 核对并更新 spend request 的公式和来源，按新公式重算历史 spend。
entries.fix_en: Review and update the spend request formula and source, then recalculate historical spend.

examples.quote: net spend是不是还是按照remerge net spend x 0.95?
remerge修改了spend计算方式

entries.name_zh: 缺 spend request / 自动录入请求
entries.desc_zh: 新链接没有 spend request 或自动录入请求，spend 没人录或没按规则录。
entries.desc_en: A link has no spend request or automation request, so spend is not entered or not entered by the rules.
entries.fix_zh: 补建 spend request（公式、来源、利润率），并补录已经漏掉的日期。
entries.fix_en: Create the spend request (formula, source, margin) and backfill the missed dates.

examples.quote: 还没有spend automation request，我这边补了一条

entries.name_zh: campaign mapping 缺失或没设自动化
entries.name_en: Campaign mapping missing or not automated
entries.desc_zh: 合作方 / MMP 的 campaign 没映射到 click URL（no_campaign_mapping），或映射了但没开自动录入（mapped_but_not_automated），有 spend 却没进系统。
entries.desc_en: The partner/MMP campaign is not mapped to a click URL (no_campaign_mapping), or is mapped but not automated (mapped_but_not_automated); spend exists but never reaches the system.
entries.fix_zh: 补上 campaign mapping 并打开自动录入，补录漏掉的日期。
entries.fix_en: Add the campaign mapping, enable automation and backfill the missed dates.

examples.quote: Remerge mapped_but_not_automated: 2; Kayzen no_campaign_mapping: 4
skipped Realtor AppsFlyer Spend Email rows with missing mapping date: 2026-10-14, click_url_id: 19643

entries.name_zh: 链接已暂停或已无数据，spend 任务还在自动录入
entries.name_en: Link paused or without data, but the spend job keeps entering spend
entries.desc_zh: click URL 已经暂停（或合作方早已没有数据），但自动录入任务没停，MMP 有零星数据就继续录 gross，net 为 0，造成只有 gross 的录入。
entries.desc_en: The click URL was paused (or the partner stopped reporting), but the automated spend job kept running; stray MMP events keep producing gross with zero net.
entries.fix_zh: 停掉该链接的自动录入任务，并清理暂停后录入的 spend。
entries.fix_en: Stop the link's automated spend job and clean up spend entered after the pause.

examples.quote: click url 18894 2026-04-10 pause了，但 CreateChimeSamsungSpendJob每日还在执行，AppsFlyer有数据，所以有录入gross
从9月份开始就没有数据，但是spend job一直在跑，是否可以pause？

entries.name_zh: spend 录到了错误的 click URL
entries.name_en: Spend entered under the wrong click URL
entries.desc_zh: 报告里 campaign 没有区分（iOS / 安卓 / CTV 混在一起，或一份报告对多条链接），spend 被录到别的链接下。
entries.desc_en: The report does not separate campaigns (iOS / Android / CTV mixed, or one report for several links), so spend lands on another link.
phrases: campaign ID和campaign name没有做区分
entries.fix_zh: 把 spend 挪回正确的 click URL；让合作方报告按 campaign 拆开。
entries.fix_en: Move the spend to the correct click URL; ask the partner to split the report by campaign.

examples.quote: 26号的spend就录错了
确定是录到这两个URL是吗？这两个URL不是CTV，一个iOS， 一个Android

entries.name_en: Fee missing or attributed to the wrong line
entries.desc_zh: 平台费、数据中心费、makegood 等额外费用没并进每日 spend，或记到了别的 campaign。
entries.desc_en: Extra fees (platform, data-centre, makegood) are not added to daily spend, or are booked under another campaign.
entries.fix_zh: 把费用按约定方式并入每日 net spend（或单列），补齐历史月份。
entries.fix_en: Add the fee to daily net spend as agreed (or as a separate line) and backfill past months.

examples.quote: Since the APAC data center fee wasn’t included in our Sep net spend, there’s still a $1,500 discrepancy between the Sep invoice and our system.

entries.name_zh: 合作方 / MMP 接口取数失败或返回空
entries.name_en: Partner / MMP API failed or returned empty
entries.desc_zh: 自动录入依赖的接口报错、超时或返回空（甚至 200 但没数据），当天 spend 没录或录成 0。
entries.desc_en: The API behind automated entry errored, timed out or returned nothing (even HTTP 200 with no data), so the day's spend is missing or zero.
alert_patterns: 获取 Report Id 失败
entries.fix_zh: 等接口恢复后重跑任务或手工补录，必要时联系合作方。
entries.fix_en: Re-run the job once the API recovers or backfill manually; contact the partner if needed.

examples.quote: error: Applovin Api code返回200,但spend数据为空
Samsung DSP reported zero impressions for 2026-08-23. Direct Spend was not created

entries.name_zh: 合作方报告缺失或格式不对
entries.desc_zh: 靠邮件 / 表格报告录入的合作方没发当天报告，或报告只有总区间、没有当天数据，无法录入。
entries.desc_en: A partner that reports by email or sheet did not send the day's report, or the report only has a total range without daily values.
entries.fix_zh: 联系合作方补发报告，收到后补录并刷新 tracker。
entries.fix_en: Ask the partner to resend the report, then backfill and refresh the tracker.

examples.quote: We are missing the Chime <> LG spend report for 10/05, will impact the spend input
并没有10/08具体的spend是多少，无法录入spend以及更新tracker

entries.desc_zh: 合作方误开（accidental unpause）、超投或停投没通知，产生了不该计的 spend，需要清零或抵扣。
entries.desc_en: The partner unpaused by mistake, over-delivered or stopped without notice, producing spend that must be zeroed or credited.
entries.fix_zh: 按合作方确认把受影响日期的 net spend 清零或抵扣。
entries.fix_en: Zero out or credit the affected dates' net spend as confirmed by the partner.

examples.quote: They confirmed it was an accidental unpause on their end, and have offered to credit for 10/20-10/22.

entries.name_zh: spend 上传到 AppsFlyer 后没显示
entries.name_en: Spend uploaded to AppsFlyer but not shown
entries.desc_zh: 系统里 spend 正常，但上传 AF 失败或延迟（约 4 小时），AF 和后台对不上，需要重传。
entries.desc_en: Spend is correct in the system, but the AppsFlyer upload failed or lags (about 4 hours), so AF and Femini disagree until re-uploaded.
entries.fix_zh: 重新上传当天 spend 到 AF，并在 4 小时后复核。
entries.fix_en: Re-upload the day's spend to AF and re-check after about 4 hours.

examples.quote: 23号今天早上我检查钱还是没有显示在AF，我又重新上传了21号的spend
There will be a discrepancy between AF and Femini now since it needs 4 hours for the spend to show in AF.

entries.desc_zh: 自动录入任务本身报错（方法不存在、空指针等），当天 spend 没录。
entries.desc_en: The automated spend job itself crashed (missing method, nil error, etc.), so the day's spend was not entered.
entries.fix_zh: 修复任务代码后重跑受影响日期。
entries.fix_en: Fix the job code and re-run the affected dates.

examples.quote: undefined method `add_bid_shading_fee_to_spend'

entries.desc_zh: 靠 Google Sheet 录入的任务遇到重复键、格式不对等，整批失败。
entries.desc_en: A Google Sheet driven job hits duplicate keys or bad formats and the whole batch fails.
entries.fix_zh: 修正表格里的重复或错误行后重跑任务。
entries.fix_en: Fix the duplicate or bad rows in the sheet and re-run the job.

examples.quote: SheetDataError: Google Sheet has duplicate date/store key

entries.name_zh: 手动改 spend 后其他地方没同步
entries.name_en: Manual spend edit not synced elsewhere
entries.desc_zh: 有人手动改了 spend，但利润率、pacing 表或 AF 没跟着改，数字前后对不上。
entries.desc_en: Someone edited spend by hand, but the margin, the pacing sheet or AF were not updated, so numbers disagree.
entries.fix_zh: 确认以哪份数据为准，统一更新系统、pacing 表和 AF。
entries.fix_en: Agree on the source of truth and update the system, pacing sheet and AF together.

examples.quote: @Cathy Deng 手动更新了系统的钱，但是pacing 这边还没修改

entries.name_zh: 新 line item 没建 mapping，有 spend 没录入
entries.name_en: New line item without mapping; spend not entered
entries.desc_zh: DSP 上新加了 line item，没有映射到任何 click URL，系统告警有 spend 但没录入。
entries.desc_en: A new DSP line item is not mapped to any click URL; the system alerts that it has spend that was not entered.
entries.fix_zh: 确认 line item 归属哪个活动，建 mapping（必要时新建链接）后补录。
entries.fix_en: Decide which campaign owns the line item, add the mapping (or a new link) and backfill.

examples.quote: 从14号开始系统告警Chime_CTV_US_CPM_Vizio_PMP_Freewheel 有新的line item 63有spend且没有录入

entries.name_zh: line item 的 spend 录到了别的 click URL 下
entries.name_en: Line item spend entered under another click URL
entries.desc_zh: line item 暂时挂在别的活动 / 链接下，spend 一并录了进去，之后再拆出来，前后数字对不上。
entries.desc_en: A line item was temporarily attached to another campaign/link and its spend was entered there, later moved out, leaving mismatched numbers.
entries.fix_zh: 把 line item 的 spend 挪到正确的链接，并告知对账同事这几天的差异。
entries.fix_en: Move the line item's spend to the correct link and tell reconciliation about the affected days.

examples.quote: 所以14-16号我把这个line item的spend一起录入在了23837下面

entries.name_zh: 一个 DSP campaign 混跑多个链接的 line item
entries.name_en: One DSP campaign runs line items of several links
entries.desc_zh: 合作方一个 campaign 下挂了属于多个 click URL 的 line item，按 campaign 录入时容易录错。
entries.desc_en: One partner campaign holds line items belonging to several click URLs, so entering by campaign easily goes wrong.
entries.fix_zh: 让一个 DSP campaign 只跑一个链接的 line item，或按 line item 级别映射。
entries.fix_en: Keep one link's line items per DSP campaign, or map at line item level.

examples.quote: 在这个campaign下不仅跑了属于24189的line item, 又跑了属于URL24305，24306的line item，这样导致spend录入的时候容易出错

entries.name_zh: 多个 line item 对应一个 click URL，拆不开
entries.name_en: Many line items map to one click URL
entries.desc_zh: mapping 里多个 line item 指向同一个 click URL，按 line item 看会重复，click URL 下拆不出来。
entries.desc_en: Several line items map to the same click URL, so line-item views double count and the link cannot be split.
entries.fix_zh: 按 adset / line item 重新设计映射，或拆分链接。
entries.fix_en: Redesign the mapping by adset / line item, or split the link.

examples.quote: Binance 的 Freewheel Campaign Mapping 存在多个 line item it 对应一个 click url 的 mapping

entries.name_zh: 新增的 creative line item 没被抓取
entries.name_en: New creative line items not captured
entries.desc_zh: 合作方新加了 creative / line item，取数只认旧的，新的曝光和 spend 没进系统。
entries.desc_en: The partner added creatives / line items, but the import only knows the old ones, so new impressions and spend are missing.
entries.fix_zh: 把新 creative / line item 纳入取数范围，补录历史。
entries.fix_en: Include the new creatives / line items in the import and backfill history.

examples.quote: It seems like since 8/6 some creative line items were added but their impressions and spend were not successfully captured.
